description: A company commander must publish next week's recertification schedule for two vehicle-operator cohorts, assign the qualified evaluator, and record the coordination actions needed with the motor pool.

shared_context.S1: The company must recertify its Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator cohorts next week.
shared_context.S2: The training area has two available four-hour blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700.
shared_context.S3: The schedule must list the evaluator for Alpha. Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle and is not part of this schedule decision.
shared_context.S4: Capt. Morgan publishes the final schedule, and the company routinely holds a training-and-maintenance coordination huddle before weekly schedules are issued.

PF1.text: The only evaluator currently authorized for the Alpha cohort is Sgt. Lewis, who is available Monday 0800-1200; SFC Patel confirmed the authorization in the training database this morning, but the evaluator roster has not yet been attached to the weekly schedule.

PF2.text: Bravo's assigned vehicles are booked for preventive maintenance Monday afternoon and Tuesday morning, so that cohort can train only Tuesday 1300-1700 after motor pool release; SFC Brooks confirmed the bay booking today, but the maintenance calendar has not been cross-referenced with the training schedule.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha must be scheduled for Monday 0800-1200 with Sgt. Lewis as its evaluator.
Bravo must be scheduled for Tuesday 1300-1700.
Bravo's vehicle-release condition must record the preventive-maintenance timing and require motor-pool release before the Tuesday 1300-1700 training block.
The settlement must include a schedule, roster, or publication commitment that places Sgt. Lewis as Alpha's evaluator on the published schedule.
The Alpha evaluator authorization fact must be cited in the commander's justification.

content_checks.C4: 'preventive maintenance' in decisions['bravo_vehicle_release_condition'] and ('motor pool release' in decisions['bravo_vehicle_release_condition'] or 'vehicle release' in decisions['bravo_vehicle_release_condition'] or 'released' in decisions['bravo_vehicle_release_condition'])
content_checks.C5: any('Sgt. Lewis' in c['detail'] and ('schedule' in c['detail'] or 'publish' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The authorized evaluator's Monday availability changes Alpha's block to Monday 0800-1200, names Sgt. Lewis, and requires the published schedule to place Sgt. Lewis on Alpha's evaluator assignment.

The preventive-maintenance booking changes Bravo's training block to Tuesday 1300-1700 and requires the vehicle-release condition to mention preventive maintenance and motor-pool or vehicle release timing.
